verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that WHOIS redaction is free, meets ICANN guidelines, and is applied by default. A hands-on community report confirms domains were redacted without the user taking any action, and the pricing page says there are no required add-ons. Redaction applies only "if permitted by the registry", so some TLDs may not get it. missing for 10: guaranteed redaction across all TLDs (registry-dependent), explicit field-level confirmation that name, address and email are each redacted.

support.subject: As a privacy-first user, WHOIS privacy is free and on by default — my name, address, and email stay redacted without an upsell

citations.quote: Cloudflare Registrar offers personal data redaction on WHOIS for free, that meets current ICANN guidelines.
Cloudflare redacts WHOIS information from your domain by default.
Contact information is redacted by default. I've moved a bunch of domains over, they're all redacted in the whois without me taking any action
with no hidden fees or required add-ons
